name: email-research-mcp
description: Bundle a local read-only research MCP with an email evidence analysis skill.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze locally exported research email with citations.
interface.longDescription: Imports explicitly exported EML or JSON files into a local Retrieval Hub, then lets Codex search and read them through a read-only MCP workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use my imported research emails to analyze a company thesis.
Compare conflicting views in my imported research emails.
Find the strongest evidence and open questions for this investment idea.
